item.explanation:
WHAT CHANGED: Starbucks added a warning that strategic initiatives, including restructuring and the China retail divestiture, can make results harder to compare across periods.
WHY IT MATTERS: The company says its restructuring plans have already resulted in restructuring and impairment charges. It also expects the China joint venture transition to lower revenue and raise operating margin compared with the historical company-operated model.
IMPORTANCE: high - realized: Restructuring and impairment charges have occurred.
EVIDENCE: "have resulted in, and may continue to result in, restructuring and impairment charges" "we expect to continue to drive lower revenues and higher operating margin"

EVIDENCE: "have resulted in, and may continue to result in, restructuring and impairment charges" "we expect to continue to drive lower revenues and higher operating margin"
